subject.title: fix(agent-core): bound harness exec stdout/stderr at 16 MiB

question: Should `Shell.exec` in agent-core default to truncating each captured stdout/stderr stream at 16 MiB, with `maxOutputBytes` as the opt-up path?
rationale: The patch fixes a real availability risk, but it changes the default capture contract for any existing caller that expected complete outputs above 16 MiB.

options.title: Accept bounded capture
options.body: Land the current 16 MiB per-stream default and treat `maxOutputBytes` as the supported path for intentional large captures.

options.title: Require opt-up proof
options.body: Ask for a focused test or note showing callers can raise `maxOutputBytes` before accepting the default cap.

options.title: Redesign default behavior
options.body: Pause this PR if full unbounded capture is still considered the current harness contract.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded capture
recommendation.body: Land the current 16 MiB per-stream default and treat `maxOutputBytes` as the supported path for intentional large captures.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to steipete as the strongest owner for the agent-core harness contract and nearby execution behavior.
